essence: All humans reverently bow down by that name.
The hundred-name hymn called her own form is proclaimed for primordial Kālī.
This hymn, endowed with preliminary rites, grants all desired fruits.
One may recite, teach, hear, or cause others to hear this hymn.
Freed from all sins, one may obtain union with brahman.
